rewardProbabilities.formula: (group ratio / group-list ratio sum) × (term weight / reward-group weight sum); duplicate type+target outcomes are summed

equipmentEnhancementProbabilities.formula: failure = 100 - successRate; destruction = dropOnFail ? round(failure × breakRate / 100) : 0

itemAcquisitionProbabilities.formula: (group ratio / group-list ratio sum) × (term weight / reward-group weight sum); duplicate type+target outcomes are summed

itemDropWeights.warning: normalizedWeightSharePercent is not an absolute monster-drop probability

monsterCodex.warning: dropItems lists seedGroup candidates, not per-kill drop odds

monsterDropSeeds.formula: topItemSharePercent = top candidate weight / Σ seedGroup candidate weights
monsterDropSeeds.warning: dropRateRaw is a client value of unconfirmed unit; it is not multiplied into a per-kill probability

zoneAtlas.warning: spawnDataFound=false means the deployed build ships no spawn rows for this zone spawnKey

cookingLevels.warning: cookProbWeightSharePercent normalizes FBDataCookProb weights; the client preview uses the Cook_Gacha_Lv* reward pools

refineAttributeValues.warning: grade D–S maps to FBDataRefineAttribute.grade 1–5 in ascending order; displayMin/displayMax divide the raw value by FBDataAttributeList.divisor

refineOptions.formula: pickPercent = optionWeight / Σ optionWeight; gradeOdds.percent = gradeWeight / Σ gradeWeight; slot unlock uses FBDataRefineSlot.unlockRate
